fr_html: Le PRESIDENT constate qu'on est d'accord pour reconnaître qu'à raison des rapports qui existent entre la question de la compétence de la Cour et celle de son organisation, le Comité a compétence pour examiner ces deux points.
en_html: The PRESIDENT stated that they were agreed that because of the connection which exists between the competence and organisation of the Court, the Committee was competent to examine these two points.
